title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
description: Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us! About AMBOSS AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.” Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique. Why Systems at AMBOSS? AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care. Why can this position be exciting for you? You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module. You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day. This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue. Where we are Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead. You will: Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model. Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work. Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant. Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved. Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions. Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible. Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it. You bring: Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases). Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags). Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT. Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools. Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements. Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use. Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues. Nice to have: Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT Proficiency in German Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate A Workday consulting or CoE background A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context You enjoy: Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months. Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands. Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait. Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first. What success looks like after your first year: The tenant runs without the implementation partner. The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does. The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end. Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on. Benefits: 🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more) 🥙Food & Office Comfort ( Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town) 🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…) Check out the full list of benefits below: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺 Even if you don’t meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

description: We’re a growing team, and as we scale, so does our need to focus on expanding our sales development team. You’ll join a people-focused business that is putting AI at the center of how manufacturers and distributors price, quote and manage incentives, with a real opportunity to accelerate your career in enterprise SaaS sales. As a Senior Sales Development Representative, you will identify and engage our ideal customers using Vendavo’s target account profile. You will lead the first stage of the customer journey, starting conversations and building early relationships through outbound prospecting, targeted campaigns, events and coordinated marketing activity. You will guide prospects through the early stages of the commercial lifecycle: discovering opportunities, qualifying interest and fit, and securing high-quality meetings for our Account Executives. You will also support the account team on key marketing activity. Your work lays the foundation for predictable, high-quality pipeline across our enterprise segment. THE OPPORTUNITY Leverage research and tailored outreach to create new opportunities with both New Logo accounts and existing customers. Run outbound prospecting (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) on strategic target accounts using concise, research-led messaging. Most of your quota will be expected to come from outbound. Qualify inbound leads against set criteria, using strong questioning to identify true fit and move the right opportunities forward. Research the business issues affecting target accounts and profile key contacts before outreach. Build a solid understanding of our technology and solutions, and clearly explain the problems we solve and the value we deliver to prospects. Lead team meetings on relevant topics, share learnings and new strategies to improve SDR performance, and take part in weekly pipeline reviews. Monitor social media for relevant trends and keywords, and share insights with the SDR, marketing and content teams. Assist in the mentorship and training of new SDRs on process, technology and the company, and act as a leader and problem solver for the team. Support the sales cycle through forecasting, data management and clear communication. Co-own sales tech stack reporting, review insights weekly and recommend changes to process, people or procedures. Contribute to and lead team meetings on a monthly basis on topics relevant to the role.  Pipeline review with weekly team meeting  Other duties as assigned.      THE SKILL SET Minimum of 5 years related work experience; bachelor's degree preferred. Consistent track record of meeting and exceeding lead generation and new account development objectives. Fluent English and German speaker. Excellent communication skills in writing, speaking, listening, and outbound calling - able to communicate clearly, concisely, and with precision. Proficiency in our sales tech stack, or the ability to become proficient quickly: Salesforce (CRM, pipeline and reporting), Gong (email outreach and engagement tracking), Common Room (contact enrichment, prospecting and intent data) and Claude (research, account planning and outreach). Stays current with AI and prospecting tools, and tests and applies them to improve outreach quality and efficiency. Experience calling into Fortune 1000 accounts preferred. Ability to understand and successfully promote technical offerings and solution sets, supported by strong curiosity about business problems and product value. Highly motivated and positive, with an entrepreneurial, self-starting mindset and strong planning skills. Demonstrated coachability - you seek feedback, apply it quickly, and continuously refine your approach. Creative approach to outreach, with the ability to build sequences and test new messaging and cadences across email, phone and social channels. Strong self-learning mindset: proactive in developing your sales craft through reading, testing, and continuous improvement. Strong ownership mentality - takes responsibility for pipeline creation, follow-through, and results without outsourcing challenges. Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift efforts based on business goals and team needs. Strong working knowledge of Claude, including running account and contact research, creating and maintaining projects with reusable context, using and building Claude skills for repeatable workflows (research, call prep, sequence drafting), and checking outputs before they reach a prospect. Ambitious about long-term career growth in sales, with a clear desire to progress into quota-carrying roles. Must be able to travel as needed (For marketing / sales events and internal meetups in Europe and Sales Kick-Off in the U.S)  THE BENEFITS Fully remote based with the flexibility to work from anywhere in Germany Flexible working hours Working within a team of friendly, skilled people where help is always within reach 30 vacation days per year in addition to public holidays 4 recharge days, where the entire company goes on a brief pause in all geographies for 1 day each quarter. This day can be spent in whatever way helps you recharge, to regain energy, and dive back into the next workday 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year Risk Insurance Travel insurance for business travels Cell phone reimbursement up to 90€ EUR per month High-end laptop (Windows or Mac) Competitive pay and bonus/commission   THE VENDAVO STORY  Vendavo partners with the world’s leading companies to accelerate growth and profitability, advance innovation, and build more prosperous communities. Our powerful, cloud-based, AI-powered pricing, selling, and prescribing solutions empower global manufacturers and distributors to manage, optimize, and digitize their end-to-end commercial processes. But we offer so much more than software. Our proven, repeatable process, and passionate, experienced people accelerate value and drive profitable, unrivaled business outcomes for our customers. We are passionate about helping our customers deliver the right products, at the right prices, at the right time, for the right people.    OUR SAAS PRODUCTS  Our B2B pricing and selling solutions include Vendavo’s Pricing & Strategy Management (Pricepoint, Enterprise Pricing Platform, Deal Price Optimizer, and Vendavo AI), Sales & Quoting Solutions (Intelligent CPQ and Sales Optimizer), Profit and Margin Analytics (Profit Analyzer and Margin Bridge Analyzer), and Incentive & Channel Operations (Rebate and Channel Manager).  You can learn more about our products here .   OUR FUNDING We are backed by two of the top high-tech private equity firms in the world, have excellent financial health, and boast the top SaaS retention in our space.   OUR CULTURE & YOU We collaborate with our customers unlike any others in our industry. Anchored in our values (Integrity, Customer Centricity, Innovation, Clarity, Collaboration), we are growing, constantly innovating, and consistently driving sustainable outcomes for our clients and partners.   Unlocking opportunities for our customers would not be possible without our employees. When you are part of Vendavo, you’re part of a company that’s committed to your growth and invested in your career. Diversity, inclusion, and celebration of community are at our core, and we come together to learn from each other and honor our commitments.   EMEA and California residents applying for positions at Vendavo can see our privacy policy  here .   OUR TEAM IS GROWING. YOU WILL TOO. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Lifecycle Manager
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Program Management Team Wayve’s Program Management team turns complex technical goals into coordinated delivery. Working closely with engineering, product, safety and validation teams, we align priorities, manage dependencies and bring clarity to ambiguous challenges. We combine technical depth with cross-functional leadership to help teams move faster, more predictably and with purpose—focusing on meaningful outcomes rather than process for its own sake. As Senior Product Lifecycle Manager, you’ll connect Wayve’s product milestones to the detailed technical plans, system-level artefacts and readiness evidence needed to deliver them. You’ll lead complex, multi-team programmes from one milestone to the next, ensuring teams work from a shared, credible plan across our Level 2 and Level 4 products. 🧠 Your day-to-day Partner with engineering and product leads to translate product milestones into integrated cross-team schedules, priorities and delivery plans. Review technical progress, backlog health, dependencies and system-level evidence to determine whether programmes are ready to move forward. Identify technical risks and sequencing bottlenecks early, then drive the decisions and mitigation plans needed to protect delivery. Facilitate difficult conversations around scope, resources and competing priorities, helping teams reach clear and practical decisions. Adapt plans quickly as technical understanding, product priorities or delivery constraints change. Communicate programme status, schedule changes, risks and decisions clearly and proactively across technical teams and senior stakeholders. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Owning and maintaining integrated lifecycle plans for complex Level 2 and Level 4 product milestones, creating a clear source of truth across teams. Managing cross-team dependencies and critical-path activities across engineering, product, safety, verification and validation. Managing system-level artefacts throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring the right information and evidence are available at each milestone. Establishing clear milestone-readiness criteria and using technical status, metrics and backlog data to support evidence-based delivery decisions. Aligning programme scope, sequencing and resource decisions with Wayve’s strategic and commercial priorities. Improving lifecycle-planning practices and tooling so teams can identify risk earlier, coordinate more effectively and deliver with greater predictability. 🙌 You should apply if: You have 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-team technical or product programmes, with responsibility for planning, execution and delivery across several engineering teams. You bring a strong background in the automotive or autonomous-vehicle industry and understand the complexity of delivering integrated vehicle and software products. You have the technical depth to work closely with engineers, evaluate complex system architectures and challenge delivery plans constructively—not simply track execution. You think in systems, understanding how technical decisions, dependencies and changes in one area affect downstream teams and product outcomes. You’re decisive under uncertainty and can make sound prioritisation and trade-off recommendations with incomplete or evolving information. You have a strong track record of identifying delivery, technical and dependency risks early and driving them through to resolution. You use metrics, technical evidence and backlog health to assess readiness and guide programme decisions. You’re product-minded and outcome-focused, connecting delivery decisions to customer value and business impact rather than process completion alone. You can facilitate challenging stakeholder conversations, resolve conflicting technical priorities and create alignment without relying on formal authority. You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, tailoring complex programme information for both technical and business audiences. You’re proficient with Jira, Confluence and modern backlog, planning and programme-management tools. Experience working in a safety-critical, regulated or complex multi-stakeholder environment would be valuable. A programme-management qualification such as PMP, CAPM or PRINCE2 would be a plus. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. raw.title: Senior Product Lifecycle Manager
raw.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Program Management Team

Wayve’s Program Management team turns complex technical goals into coordinated delivery. Working closely with engineering, product, safety and validation teams, we align priorities, manage dependencies and bring clarity to ambiguous challenges. We combine technical depth with cross-functional leadership to help teams move faster, more predictably and with purpose—focusing on meaningful outcomes rather than process for its own sake.

As Senior Product Lifecycle Manager, you’ll connect Wayve’s product milestones to the detailed technical plans, system-level artefacts and readiness evidence needed to deliver them. You’ll lead complex, multi-team programmes from one milestone to the next, ensuring teams work from a shared, credible plan across our Level 2 and Level 4 products.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Partner with engineering and product leads to translate product milestones into integrated cross-team schedules, priorities and delivery plans.

  • Review technical progress, backlog health, dependencies and system-level evidence to determine whether programmes are ready to move forward.

  • Identify technical risks and sequencing bottlenecks early, then drive the decisions and mitigation plans needed to protect delivery.

  • Facilitate difficult conversations around scope, resources and competing priorities, helping teams reach clear and practical decisions.

  • Adapt plans quickly as technical understanding, product priorities or delivery constraints change.

  • Communicate programme status, schedule changes, risks and decisions clearly and proactively across technical teams and senior stakeholders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Owning and maintaining integrated lifecycle plans for complex Level 2 and Level 4 product milestones, creating a clear source of truth across teams.

  • Managing cross-team dependencies and critical-path activities across engineering, product, safety, verification and validation.

  • Managing system-level artefacts throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring the right information and evidence are available at each milestone.

  • Establishing clear milestone-readiness criteria and using technical status, metrics and backlog data to support evidence-based delivery decisions.

  • Aligning programme scope, sequencing and resource decisions with Wayve’s strategic and commercial priorities.

  • Improving lifecycle-planning practices and tooling so teams can identify risk earlier, coordinate more effectively and deliver with greater predictability.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-team technical or product programmes, with responsibility for planning, execution and delivery across several engineering teams.

  • You bring a strong background in the automotive or autonomous-vehicle industry and understand the complexity of delivering integrated vehicle and software products.

  • You have the technical depth to work closely with engineers, evaluate complex system architectures and challenge delivery plans constructively—not simply track execution.

  • You think in systems, understanding how technical decisions, dependencies and changes in one area affect downstream teams and product outcomes.

  • You’re decisive under uncertainty and can make sound prioritisation and trade-off recommendations with incomplete or evolving information.

  • You have a strong track record of identifying delivery, technical and dependency risks early and driving them through to resolution.

  • You use metrics, technical evidence and backlog health to assess readiness and guide programme decisions.

  • You’re product-minded and outcome-focused, connecting delivery decisions to customer value and business impact rather than process completion alone.

  • You can facilitate challenging stakeholder conversations, resolve conflicting technical priorities and create alignment without relying on formal authority.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, tailoring complex programme information for both technical and business audiences.

  • You’re proficient with Jira, Confluence and modern backlog, planning and programme-management tools.

  • Experience working in a safety-critical, regulated or complex multi-stakeholder environment would be valuable.

  • A programme-management qualification such as PMP, CAPM or PRINCE2 would be a plus.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our London office.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency Interviews (HM Call; 60 minutes)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Stakeholder Management, Delivery Use Case; 2 hours)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (45 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>The Company You’ll Join</h2> <p>Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. description: <h2><strong>Pre-Sales Solution Consultant (People Analytics)</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Who We Are</strong></h3> <p>One Model is seeking a passionate <strong>Pre-Sales Solutions Consultant</strong> to help us scale our market presence in EMEA and bridge the gap between deep HR data capability, Workforce Intelligence, AI Measurement and Transformation,&nbsp; and strategic business value.</p> <p>With customers and staff around the world, One Model offers a complete workforce intelligence platform along with a cutting-edge AI Impact evaluation tool.&nbsp; Our products feature cloud-hosted data orchestration and advanced visualization and analytics tools all controllable via AI interfaces. Our platforms enable companies to unlock the real value of their HR and AI usage&nbsp; data from the lens of the workforce.</p> <p><strong>This isn't your standard, script-reading sales demonstration role.</strong> We aren't looking for a "demo expert" who only knows which buttons to click, nor are we looking for someone with extensive People Analytics or HR experience.</p> <p><strong>The ideal fit:</strong> You are a proven pre-sales consultant who loves being a part of the sales process. You are eager to learn about HR, Workforce Intelligence, and AI Organizational Transformation,&nbsp; and are ready to incorporate that knowledge into the demonstration process. In other words, you’re going to learn about Workforce Intelligence and AI Transformation,&nbsp; and combine that with your demonstration expertise so you can confidently present how our products support Workforce Intelligence, AI Transformation, and Technical teams in their mission.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>As a critical partner to our sales team, you will showcase the business value, scalability, and strategic impact of One Model products to prospective enterprise customers:</p> <ul> <li><strong>High-Impact Demos:</strong> Prepare for and deliver live, dynamic product demonstrations tailored to the specific organizational and HR and AI transformational and measurement challenges of prospects.</li> <li><strong>Tailored Use Cases:</strong> Create custom content, metrics, and data mockups in the products to showcase specific HR scenarios (TA, Comp, L&amp;D, retention, and AI Impact and measurement use cases, etc.) .</li> <li><strong>RFP &amp; Functional Support:</strong> Partner with Account Executives (AEs) to navigate complex RFPs, write functional descriptions of product capabilities, and handle ad-hoc product queries.</li> <li><strong>Content Creation:</strong> Record engaging product videos to showcase features and drive market excitement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Project Work: Engage in projects designed to support the sales team and reinforce our pre-sales activities.&nbsp;</strong><strong>Event Engagement: Attend local and regional events, delivering demonstrations on-site, speaking to audiences about the value of One Model products, and interacting with prospects as part of the sales process.&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3><strong>About You</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Pre-Sales Expertise:</strong> You are an experienced HR, Workforce Intelligence, and/or AI transformational software pre-sales professional who can learn a platform quickly, demonstrate with authority, and adjust your flow quickly to prospect questions and demands. You are able to quickly learn our products and basic people analytics concepts so that you can establish yourself as a knowledgeable trusted advisor in the sales process.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Gets it Done: </strong>You get it done, quickly and correctly.&nbsp; You aren’t afraid to jump into the deep end and absorb as much as you can as fast as you can. You know each demonstration is an opportunity to grow and improve.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Not Afraid to Sell: </strong>You understand that this role is a critical part of the sales process and as such, you are able to build excitement about the One Model products and clearly explain its value proposition.</li> <li><strong>Natural Charisma &amp; Presence:</strong> You are an exceptional communicator who commands a room or a web call. You genuinely enjoy meeting new people, building rapport quickly, and reading an audience to adjust your presentation style on the fly.</li> <li><strong>The Storyteller &amp; Translator:</strong> You can develop a people analytics mindset, but your real superpower is translation. You can confidently discuss advanced analytics, metrics development, and system adoption with CHROs, HR leaders, AI Transformational Officers just as easily as you can discuss data logic with IT and Technical Buyers buyers.</li> <li><strong>Thrives in Momentum:</strong> You are adaptable, comfortable with a fast-paced scale-up environment, and can manage your time effectively when juggling multiple priorities.</li> <li><strong>What This Role Is NOT:</strong> This is a consultative, high customer-facing pre-sales role, NOT a backend data analytics or engineering position, nor is it a post-sales consulting role. This is not an applied People Analytics role, nor does it involve coding or data architecture work.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> We are a remote organization, supporting our employees to work from home. Ideally, you will be located near London, but we will consider candidates in the UK, followed by candidates in continental Europe.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Schedule: Hours of operations may vary depending on business needs. This role does provide some support for Account Executives located in the Eastern Time Zone in the US. As such, there will be situations where you will be expected to respond to Slack messages and support calls into the evening hours (London time).&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3><strong>Want to skip the line and guarantee your application gets reviewed?</strong></h3> <p>The "Show Us Your Spark" Video Challenge:</p> <p>While this video is optional, candidates who submit a video will be heavily prioritized and fast-tracked straight to the interview round. We are looking for people who can command a room, so this is your chance to stand out.</p> <p>We don't want a long, dry, feature-by-feature software demo. Instead, record a quick 2-to-3-minute video (using Loom, Zoom, or your phone) answering one of the prompts below:</p> <ul> <li>The 2-Minute Pitch. Pitch us your favorite app or tool on your phone right now. You have 2 minutes to make us want to download it immediately.</li> </ul> <p>The Golden Rule: Keep it under 3 minutes. If it feels like a dry, robotic corporate slide-read, you're doing it wrong! We aren’t grading your video editing or lighting; we are looking for your natural charisma, clarity, and ability to keep an audience engaged. Have fun with it.</p> <h4><strong>How to Submit Your Video:</strong></h4> <p>Please email your video file or link (Loom, YouTube, Drive, etc.) directly to ----- with the subject line: [Your Name] - Solutions Consultant Video Entry. Ensure your standard application is also submitted through our job board.</p> <h3><strong>We Support You As An Individual By</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Fostering a friendly, inclusive, respectful workplace culture.</li> <li>Supporting flexible work options, including 100% remote work and flexible hours.</li> <li>Coaching and development through our "Growing Together" conversations.</li> <li>Generous compensation, benefits, and professional mental health support (EAP).</li> </ul> <p><em>At One Model, we see the immense value of a diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply for the role even if you don't think you check every single box.</em></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£100,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£115,000 GBP</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.</p> <p>The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.</p> <p>You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. We agree the goal, and you find the way</span></li> <li><span data-preserver-spaces="true"><strong>Unlimited growth potential.</strong> We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.</span></li> <li><span data-preserver-spaces="true"><strong>Skills that compound for life.</strong> Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.</span></li> <li><span data-preserver-spaces="true"><strong>Master the highest bar in the world.</strong> Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.</span></li> <li><span data-preserver-spaces="true"><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our conferences</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Your Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the audience.</strong> Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.</li> <li><strong>Own marketing channels that drive revenue. </strong>Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue</li> <li><strong>Write copy that persuades.</strong> Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.</li> <li><strong>Sprint, test, implement.</strong> Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.</li> <li><strong>Build systems, not one-offs.</strong> Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.</li> <li><strong>Do whatever it takes to win.</strong> Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value to the client.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">What we expect from you</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-preserver-spaces="true">You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:</span></p> <ul> <li>1 to 3 years of experience</li> <li>Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results</li> <li>A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.</li> <li>Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency</li> <li>Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do</li> <li>Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do</li> <li>A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people</li> <li>Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>Practical details</h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Role is full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week.</p> <p>Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year.</p> <p>The start date is flexible.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.</p> <p>Empowering the world starts with living <a href="https://ouraring.com/about-us">our values</a> and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.&nbsp;</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Oura is rebuilding how it builds software. Every engineer has agentic tooling, and our own pipeline already takes a well-formed ticket to a reviewed, tested commit stack. It runs interactively, headless, and on a cloud sandbox fleet, with its own evals and tracing. We are looking for engineers who use AI as a fundamental building block of both the products we ship and the way we build them.</p> <p>That is a strong start on one stage of the lifecycle. The next step is the whole loop. As a Staff Engineer on the AI Transformation team, you will architect and own the system that turns agentic development from something power users do into the way hundreds of engineers across iOS, Android, backend and AI services ship every day. That means spec and intake, planning, implementation, review, testing, CI/CD, release, observability and incident follow-up, each with agents doing real work and humans keeping judgment where it matters.</p> <p>This is a fast-moving, LLM-forward team. We prioritize rapid prototyping, iterative loops and AI-native development, with the speed of a startup and the reach of a product used by millions of members. You can work hybrid from our UK office in London. You will need the existing right to work in the UK; we are not able to sponsor a visa for this role.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will build the pipeline, measure it, and make it trustworthy enough that teams choose it. Success is measured in validated changes reaching members faster and safer: time to a trustworthy signal, escaped defects, cost per merged change, and how many squads run on the paved path because it is better, not because they were told to.</p> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>You don't need to do all of these on day one, but these are the kinds of problems you'll own:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Set the technical direction for the agentic pipeline:</strong> Make our existing ticket-to-PR pipeline dependable infrastructure. Own its architecture, including agent orchestration, context management and tool calling, and improve its reliability, throughput, cost and developer experience across mobile, backend and web repositories. Run it unattended where the risk allows.</li> <li><strong>Close the loop across the SDLC:</strong> Extend agentic workflows beyond code generation into spec quality checks, test generation, automated review, CI failure triage and repair, release verification, and post-deploy signals, so the system improves from what happens after merge.</li> <li><strong>Prototype fast, then harden:</strong> Get a new workflow running in days, prove it on real tickets with real squads, and turn what holds up into production infrastructure.</li> <li><strong>Run AI in production properly:</strong> Agents in production take more than an API call. Own the eval sets, LLM-as-a-judge grading, versioning, tracing and dashboards that tell us whether a workflow change made things better, including the hardest case: a change that passes CI and is still wrong. Track the numbers that matter (merge rate, rework, time-to-signal, cost per change, escaped defects) and make them visible to engineers and leadership.</li> <li><strong>Make autonomy safe:</strong> Design sandboxing, permissions, human checkpoints and guardrails proportional to risk, with privacy by design as the default. Health data, security and infrastructure changes get stronger controls; low-risk, easily verified work runs hands-off.</li> <li><strong>Lead AI-native engineering by example:</strong> Set the bar for AI-augmented engineering across the organization. Show in your own work what a pipeline-first engineer ships, and raise the craft of the engineers around you.</li> <li><strong>Drive adoption with the teams:</strong> Embed with squads and their AI DRIs, find where the pipeline breaks on real work, fix the system rather than the single output, and turn what works into paved paths, skills, templates and docs other engineers can extend.</li> <li><strong>Partner cross-functionally:</strong> Work with platform, developer productivity, security and privacy, AI infrastructure, mobile and backend squads, product and design, and engineering leadership to make trade-offs explicit and keep everyone moving on one system instead of five parallel ones.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Requirements</strong></h2> <p>We'd love to hear from you if you are:</p> <ul> <li><strong>An experienced builder:</strong> Building and operating production systems that other engineers depend on, including developer tooling, internal platforms, or AI infrastructure at scale. We weigh demonstrated outcomes over years.</li> <li><strong>Proven with agentic loops in production:</strong> You have built and operated agentic coding workflows or autonomous loops in a real engineering organization, beyond demos: background agents producing PRs, automated review, CI repair, test generation, or similar, with adoption and measured results.</li> <li><strong>A whole-lifecycle thinker:</strong> You reason about specification, review, testing, CI/CD, release and operations as one system, and you know where the bottleneck moves when code generation gets cheap.</li> <li><strong>A technical leader:</strong> You set direction across teams you don't manage, write the designs others build on, and are trusted with the hard calls on architecture and risk.</li> <li><strong>Strong on fundamentals:</strong> mobile domain or backend APIs, concurrency, distributed systems, testing, debugging and reliability. You treat AI output as a draft and can show how you verify it.</li> <li><strong>Technically versatile:</strong> Fluency in one domain of backend, iOS, or Android, with a stretch into others. You use the tools available to work across platforms and pick up new stacks quickly.</li> <li><strong>Security and privacy conscious:</strong> You understand the responsibility of handling sensitive personal data and of giving agents access to real systems, and you design for both from the start.</li> <li><strong>High agency:</strong> You thrive in ambiguity and shape the requirements yourself through experimentation.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative and resilient:</strong> You bring teams along, take feedback from engineers who are skeptical, share credit, and keep going when experiments fail or the tooling changes under you. You communicate clearly with engineers, managers and non-engineering partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Would be a benefit</strong></h2> <p>You don't need all of these, but they're nice signals of fit:</p> <ul> <li>Experience with coding agents at depth: skills, MCP servers, hooks, sub-agent orchestration, headless runs.</li> <li>Built evaluation harnesses or benchmarks for coding agents, or LLM-as-judge grading tied to build and test outcomes.</li> <li>Experience with sandboxed execution at scale: ephemeral dev environments, VM or container fleets, macOS build infrastructure.</li> <li>Background in developer productivity measurement (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4) and in turning metrics into decisions without turning them into targets.</li> <li>Shipped to mobile apps or other environments with slow, expensive feedback loops.</li> <li>Experience in digital health, wearables, MedTech, or other privacy-sensitive or regulated products.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source AI projects, or a portfolio of projects built on the latest agent capabilities.</li> <li>Mentored engineers or led an engineering community of practice.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <div>At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health and add to our benefits!<br>What we offer:</div> <ul> <li>Competitive salary</li> <li>An Oura Ring of your own + employee discounts for friends &amp; family</li> <li>Flexible working hours</li> <li>Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers</li> </ul> <div>If this sounds like the next step for you, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible.</div><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="styles--2Kv6p" data-ui="careers-page-content"> <p>ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Payoneer</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.</p> <p>By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.</p></div><p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Location: London</strong></p> <p><strong>Hybrid</strong></p> <p><strong>Full-Time</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer.</p> <p>This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. Drive deals to close dates and call your number straight.</li> <li><strong>Set up the win for the long term. </strong>Land with a clean handoff to Customer Success and a clear expansion thesis, so every logo you close becomes a growth account.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with a strong bias toward new business / new logo acquisition — not primarily account management or renewals.</li> <li>Consistent, demonstrable record of hitting or exceeding a new-business quota on complex, high-value deals.</li> <li>Proven ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound and to break into cold enterprise accounts at the executive level.</li> <li>Experience closing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful (six- to seven-figure) contract value.</li> <li>Demonstrated success selling into and navigating executive buying committees — CFO, Treasury, Finance, Compliance/Risk.</li> <li>Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including running procurement, legal, and margin-protective deal structuring to close.</li> <li>Fluency operating in a matrix environment and orchestrating a cross-functional pursuit team.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling a multi-product platform and structuring land-and-expand entry deals.</li> <li>Familiarity with a structured sales methodology (Payoneer uses Sandler).</li> <li>Exposure to compliance-sensitive, regulated sales environments (KYC/AML-aware selling).</li> <li>Strong CRM discipline and data-driven pipeline management (e.g., Salesforce).</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> title: Senior Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>We are the platform turning browsing into shopping</strong>. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.</p> <p>We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.</p> <p>In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company <a href="https://corp.flipp.com/">Flipp</a>, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.</p> <p>Ready to&nbsp;<strong>spark</strong> your growth with us?</p></div><p><strong>WHO WE LOOK FOR</strong><strong> 🦄</strong></p> <p>Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.</p> <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.</p> <p>You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO </strong>🏄</p> <p><strong>Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.</li> <li>Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.</li> <li>Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Cases and Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.</li> <li>Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.</li> <li>Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Product Discovery and Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.</li> <li>Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.</li> <li>Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Alignment and Stakeholder Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.</li> <li>Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.</li> <li>Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.</li> <li>Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL NEED</strong><strong> </strong>🪄</p> <p><strong>Must-haves</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Digital advertising foundations:</strong> supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.</li> <li>Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.</li> <li>High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.</li> <li>Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.</li> <li>Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.</li> <li>Stakeholder management, with the confidence to work across markets and levels of seniority.</li> <li>A scrappy, curious and confident approach. You’re hungry to make an impact.</li> </ul> <p>👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <p><strong>NICE TO HAVE&nbsp; </strong><strong>🎆</strong></p> <ul> <li>Retail, CPG, or retail media background</li> <li>Multi-market experience</li> <li>Can speak Italian or German</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>LOCATION 🌐</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>While we have offices in Milan, Berlin, Barcelona, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full remote available), empowering you to work where you're most effective.</p> <p><strong>HOURS&nbsp;</strong>⏰<br>Your manager and several partner teams are in North America, so you’ll need to be flexible about working some later hours, beyond a standard 9-5 CET.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY</strong><strong> 🤗</strong></p> <p>🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company</p> <p>🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment</p> <p>🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work</p> <p>📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions</p> <p>🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups</p> <p>🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks</p> <p>💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are</p> <p>🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHO WE ARE </strong>💜&nbsp;</p> <p>We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Progress Over Perfection</strong>: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Clarity Through Transparency</strong>: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Learn Loudly</strong>: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Challenge with Empathy</strong>: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.</strong><br><br><br></p> <p><br><em>If you choose to apply for this specific job position and submit your application, which may include personal data such as your identifying details, contact information, curriculum vitae, cover letter, professional qualifications, and/or employment history, please be informed that your data may be shared with our Affiliates*, including Offerista Group GmbH and Flipp Operations Inc. The aforementioned entities will act as joint controllers for the limited purpose of intra-group sharing related to the evaluation of candidates’ applications. This means that your data may be processed by the Affiliate to assess your application and, if deemed suitable, to contact you regarding potential employment opportunities. However, please note that from the moment an Affiliate initiates direct contact with you and engages in any further processing of your personal data beyond the initial intra-group sharing for evaluation purposes, such Affiliate shall act as an independent data controller. In such cases, the processing of your personal data will be subject to the specific privacy policies that can be found&nbsp;</em><a href="https://shopfully.com/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy/"><em>here.</em></a></p> <p><em>* Affiliates shall mean any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by or is under common control with ShopFully SpA and its Affiliates’ subsidiaries, meaning any entity which is directly or indirectly controlled by the Affiliates.</em></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 18px;"><strong>How We Support You</strong></span></p> <p>Our Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure that you are rewarded for impact, take part in accelerated career growth, thrive with highly flexible benefits, and are empowered to do your best work in a remote-first environment. In alignment with our overall Total Rewards Philosophy, we believe compensation should be fair, clear, consistent, and aligned to growth.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Italy Base Hiring Range:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€50.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€70.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Alternance - Commercial·e / Sales / Business Developer
description: Le département Sales compte une trentaine de personnes réparties entre la qualification des prospects et le closing. Leur objectif commun : accompagner les prospects jusqu’à la signature du contrat en Assemblée Générale. Notre cycle de vente est long et complexe en BtoC (3 à 4 mois en moyenne). La particularité ? La copropriété doit voter à la majorité lors de son assemblée générale pour souscrire à notre solution. En tant qu’ alternant·e Sales Development Representative , tu es le premier point de contact et le premier maillon de notre chaîne commerciale. Ton rôle est stratégique : transformer l’intérêt d’un prospect en une opportunité commerciale réelle pour les Account Executives. Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente. Tes missions en soutien de l'équipe Sales En binôme avec nos commerciaux et sous la responsabilité de ton/ta manager, tu seras formé·e pour découvrir le métier de Sales Development Representative (SDR). Tes missions consisteront à : • Prendre en main la qualification : Réaliser les premiers échanges téléphoniques avec les prospects ayant formulé une demande de devis pour instaurer un premier contact de confiance. • Comprendre les besoins : T'entraîner à analyser les problématiques rencontrées au sein des copropriétés et présenter les offres Matera. • Assister les Account Executives : Participer à la prise de rendez-vous de démonstration et épauler les AE dans le suivi des prospects, la préparation des assemblées générales et les tâches administratives. • Découvrir nos outils Sales : Participer à la tenue à jour de notre CRM (Hubspot) et appliquer les bonnes pratiques de suivi. • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue : Proposer tes idées et participer aux projets internes visant à fluidifier nos processus commerciaux. Ton parcours d'intégration & d'apprentissage : • Deux semaines d'immersion : Découverte de nos métiers, de nos équipes et de notre vision globale. • Intégration à la Sales Academy : Tout du long de ta formation, tu bénéficieras d'un accompagnement sur mesure (formations techniques sur la copropriété, ateliers pratiques sur les méthodes de vente). • Suivi régulier : Des échanges hebdomadaires avec ton/ta manager pour accompagner ta montée en compétences et lever tes blocages. • Perspective d'évolution : En fonction de ta progression et de ton projet, tu pourras élargir ton champ d'apprentissage en découvrant les étapes suivantes du cycle de vente auprès de nos Account Executives. Les avantages : Les plus : Salaire : selon grille syntec Une forte montée en compétence sur les métiers de Sales, la vente complexe, la connaissance de l’environnement start-up et immobilier, Poursuite possible en CDI avec évolution en Account Executive par la suite. Wellpass pour faire du sport à petits prix Tickets resto (Swile) - pris en charge à 50% Accès à la plateforme Leeto pour avoir accès à des activités à prix réduit via le CSE Temps de Trajet Responsable (TTR) : 1 jour de congé supplémentaire par an, découpable en 2 demi-journées et rémunéré comme un congé payé, pour inciter à choisir des modes de transports responsables, Congés menstruels : 1 jour de congé par mois, pour mieux gérer les règles douloureuses, La base légale : Prise en charge des transports à 50% Mutuelle & Carte Swile - pris en charge à 50% Prise en charge de la prévoyance à 100% Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis Informations pratiques : Localisation : Paris 10e Type de contrat : Alternance (un ou deux ans) Date de démarrage : Octobre 2026 Rythme obligatoire : 3 semaines en entreprise / une semaine à l’école. Idéalement, tu : As un bon relationnel, tu es à l’écoute et tu te sens à l’aise au téléphone Aimes trouver des solutions pour tes clients et tu aimes convaincre ton audience As envie de monter en compétences et d’évoluer sur les métiers Sales Recherches une alternance d’un ou deux ans et tu parles français couramment Bonus : tu as déjà réalisé des jobs étudiant/ jobs d’été/ missions d’interim’ (restauration, vente, accueil, événementiel, animation, etc.) Tu hésites entre les challenges de la vente complexe en B2C et le plaisir de parler à des individus très différents pour les fédérer autour d’un projet ? Tu apprécies autant les outils digitaux que rencontrer tes prospects là où ils se trouvent ? Tu rêves d’une équipe où tout le monde s’entraide pour atteindre et dépasser ses objectifs, sans oublier de passer de bons moments ensemble, pendant ou après les heures de bureau ? De participer à la création d’un leader européen des services immobiliers ? Ne cherche plus et postule pour nous rejoindre ! Déroulement des entretiens : Pour postuler, il te suffit d’un CV, mais pas de lettre de motivation classique et interminable, dis-nous simplement pourquoi tu souhaites rejoindre Matera à ce poste ! Entretien téléphonique avec un.e recruteuse (15-20 min) Entretien technique avec deux Account Executive pour une mise en situation en visio (30 min) Rencontre nos Sales Manager,  Inès ,  Justine   Offre sous 24/48h 🎉 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
