raw.title: AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)
raw.description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.

  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique.

  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network.

  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...

  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute.

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos du poste

Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise.

Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous.

Les missions :

  • Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine).

  • Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS).

  • Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée.

  • Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu.

  • Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle.

  • Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord.

  • Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act).

  • S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts.

  • Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR.

▪️ Le profil idéal

  • 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA
  • Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...)
  • Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A)
  • Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte
  • Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles
  • Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu
  • Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA

Un plus

  • Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…)
  • Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD 
  • Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini),
  • Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions
  • Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent
  • Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks

▪️ L'ancrage Toulousain

L'agence SFEIR Toulouse regroupe une équipe à taille humaine de plus de 10 expert·e·s de haut niveau. Tu y bénéficies de la proximité et de l'agilité d'une structure locale, tout en adossant tes projets à la solidité financière et technique d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à la vie de la scène tech locale (DevFest Toulouse, SFEIR Talks, afterworks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D et l'intégration des LLMs au niveau régional.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Toulouse.
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

raw.title: Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist
raw.description:
The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist supports new customers through the Didomi onboarding cycle, from Kick-Off to deployment and handover to the Customer Success team. The role is the entry point into the Customer Onboarding career path and is performed under the guidance of the Onboarding unit manager.

The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist builds knowledge of the Didomi product suite and of customer privacy needs, keeps customer data up to date in Planhat, and relays customer feedback to the relevant internal teams.

Key Activities : 

  • Manage a defined portfolio of new customers of lower complexity (Growth Business), with a volume adapted to the learning curve. 

  • Run the onboarding steps with support: Pre-Kick-Off, Kick-Off, setup and follow-up calls, Go-live monitoring, Platform Demo / QA, and closure

  • Deliver standard product training sessions and share FAQs and Help Center content so that customers become autonomous

  • Handle first-level implementation issues during the Onboarding phase and is an intermediate to the Support team.

  • Flag onboarding risks (ghost customers, blocked projects) and apply the standard reminder and escalation rules

  • Keep Planhat up to date in real time (owner, onboarding stage, date, tier, health, ghosting flag)

  • Gather customer context from the Account Executive before Kick-Off and prepare the handover documentation for the CSM or KAM

  • Collect customer feedback and log it for the Onboarding unit

  • Contribute, with support, to a transverse initiative (documentation, training content, FAQs)

Autonomy and Decision-making : 

  • Works under supervision and within defined onboarding playbooks and internal rules

  • Follows the standard onboarding process and prioritizes daily actions with guidance

  • Escalates technical complexity, blocked projects, and ghost-customer risks to the Onboarding unit manager,Product team or the Support team. 

  • Validates any workaround, exception, or on-hold decision with the Onboarding unit manager. 

Working Relationships :

  • Internal: Onboarding unit, Sales, Pre-Sales, CSM, Support, Product, Finance. 

  • External: Customers (platform users and operational contacts), agencies, partners. 

Required Skills and Competencies : 

  • Customer service mindset: empathy, teaching ability, and capacity to simplify

  • Basic understanding of SaaS products and web technologies

  • Ability to organize and prioritize several customer projects in parallel, with guidance

  • Rigor in updating CRM tools such as Planhat

  • Curiosity for product and privacy topics

  • Good verbal and written communication skills, and comfort with presenting in kick-off calls and training sessions

  • Full professional proficiency in English


Recruitment Process : 

  • HR Screen (15 minutes)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes)

  • Case Study Presentation (1h)

  • Founder Interview

Développement des équipes
- Être exemplaire dans son leadership.
- Fournir des feedbacks constructifs en temps réel et des évaluations formelles.
- Identifier les opportunités de développement et affecter stratégiquement les collaborateurs.
- Veiller à la motivation et à la cohésion des équipes.

Les plus :   Tu as une connaissances des sujets recouvrement / crédit ("plus" supplémentaire si c'est dans le secteur/contexte de l'Énergie), Tu as une connaissance des environnements data/cloud (GCP), et des outils d'automatisation, Tu as une connaissance du Machine Learning et de l’IA. Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ?  Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit ! Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment ! Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:   - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently   Ready to help shape the future of work? Explore your future career 🔭 As our new Strategic Account Executive , you will drive Malt's growth across the French market by winning high-impact Enterprise accounts. You will join the Enterprise Sales team, leading complex acquisition cycles from initial contact to contract execution. You will focus on large French enterprises, navigating complex procurement ecosystems and strategic decision-makers. Key responsibilities ✨ Execute targeted account prospecting strategies to identify and engage multi-stakeholder entry points across enterprise accounts. Lead in-depth discovery and qualification using a structured sales framework (Meddic, BANT, SPIN..) to validate business pain points, metrics, and economic buyers. Build compelling, ROI-driven business cases and tailored value proposals that resonate with C-level executives and procurement leaders.  Coordinate Proof of Value (PoV) and pilot programs to validate operational readiness, product capabilities and accelerate conversion of our Marketplace use cases. Manage complex, multi-entity MSA commercial negotiations to close high-value, scalable agreements. Orchestrate internal cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Bid Management, and Account Management) to ensure seamless deal structuring and post-signature handover. Maintain high CRM hygiene, accurate pipeline tracking, and rigorous forecasting in Salesforce. About you 🧑‍🚀 Proven track record (5+ years) in B2B enterprise sales, successfully closing complex, high-value deals (MSAs) with large corporations. French on a native level and English on a fluent level, with outstanding executive communication and presentation skills. Deep mastery of enterprise sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Value Selling) and disciplined pipeline management in CRM tools (Salesforce). Strong business acumen and commercial negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders, HR leaders, and Procurement departments. How to join the mission? 🚀 First call with Agathe , our Talent Acquisition Lead, to better understand your background, aspirations, and answer any questions you may have. (30-45 minutes) Interview with your future manager, Julien , to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role. (45-60 minutes) Business case in order to assess your technical skills in enterprise strategy and ROI modeling . Final interview with a C-level executive to discuss Malt’s long-term vision and your role in our expansion. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Security monitoring & incident response

· Investigate security alerts and incidents, support incident handling, and contribute to root-cause analysis, remediation and post-incident reviews.

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

· Create and maintain security procedures, incident-response playbooks, operational documentation and technical standards. 

Roadmap, watch & knowledge sharing

· Keep an active watch on threats and security news, and share what you learn with the team.

Experience & seniority 

· You have at least 5 years of professional experience in Security Operations, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure Security, Cloud Security or a related field (network, systems or cloud engineering with a strong security component).

Mindset & collaboration 

· You are passionate about cybersecurity and interested in automation and the DevOps culture; you would rather automate a process than repeat it. 

· You are analytical, autonomous, versatile and rigorous, with a strong sense of service and good synthesis skills. 

· You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and you are confident in your expertise without losing the team spirit.

· Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform or an equivalent cloud environment. 

· An active interest in security news, emerging threats, conferences and meetups.

title: Team Lead - Invoices
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role Invoices is BLP's largest product. Every day, it decides whether a supplier invoice can be posted to the customer's ERP without a human touching it. The invoice team builds and runs that product. This is a leadership job with three parts that are equally important: Build the team. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. You hire, onboard, and grow engineers, and you develop the subteam leads who will carry more of the line management as we scale. Deliver for our biggest customers. Some of the largest enterprises in Europe are rolling out BLP right now. Their go-lives, automation rates, and escalations land on your desk, and you make sure the team delivers on what we promised. Turn the team into an empowered product team. Today, a lot of work still arrives as requests through proxies. You lead the shift toward a team that owns its problem space, defines outcomes, measures them, and decides what to build. As Engineering Team Lead for Invoices, you lead the team that owns BLP's invoice product: You own the team's roadmap, delivery, people, and hiring. This job is for you if you want to lead a strong engineering team through its next phase of growth and own the result. You report to the Director of Product Engineering and work closely with the other product team leads, product management, and the go-to-market organization (project managers, customer success, and sales). The team is organized in subteams, each with its own lead, and you are the person who keeps them aligned. What you'll do Lead and grow the team Run regular 1:1s, ensure growth of the engineers in your team, review progress, and make promotion and ranking decisions together with engineering leadership. Coach and develop subteam leads, and set up the subteam structure as the team grows. Keep a distributed team connected and productive: clear working agreements, transparent planning, and a culture where people raise problems early. Hire Own hiring for the team end to end: define the profiles, screen candidates, run interviews, review coding challenges, and close offers together with Talent Acquisition. Keep a high bar while hiring at pace (our current target is around two new engineers per month), and make sure every new joiner has an onboarding plan and a buddy. Own the roadmap and priorities Build the quarterly roadmap and run monthly planning with product owners and product management, prioritizing by customer impact, revenue, and strategic value. Balance enterprise go-lives, automation improvements, platform migration, developer experience, operations, and new products, and say no when something does not move the product forward. Escalate early and clearly when priorities conflict, and communicate decisions to the go-to-market organization. Deliver for strategic enterprise customers Take responsibility for the engineering side of large enterprise go-lives: requirements engineering, solution design, test and fix cycles, and go-live readiness. Work directly with project managers and, where needed, with customer stakeholders and their IT teams, and give clear, regular engineering updates. Close gaps in the product rather than per customer, so the next enterprise customer arrives on a platform that already handles their case. You have a strong backend engineering background and can still read, review, and discuss production code and system design with senior engineers. You have hired many engineers yourself, you know what a high bar looks like, and you can run a structured interview process. You have delivered complex software for enterprise customers, including demanding go-lives, and you are comfortable in a room with customer stakeholders. You prioritize ruthlessly, communicate trade-offs clearly, and can hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives while keeping the relationship. You develop people: you give direct feedback, set measurable goals, and help engineers grow into leads. You take ownership, surface problems early, ask for help when you are stuck, and hold your team to the same standard. You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, since many of our customers and colleagues are in the DACH region. What you'll get A real mandate. You own the invoice team end to end: people, hiring, roadmap, and delivery. Engineers from serious academic and industry backgrounds who care about doing the work well, with subteam leads already in place. A smooth handover. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. Our partner is looking for an Account Manager — New Business & Closing (m/f/d) based in Switzerland. As an Account Manager specializing in new business and closing, you will turn qualified sales opportunities into signed partnerships, helping businesses unlock the commercial potential of loyalty programmes. You will manage the full sales cycle, from discovery and solution development to presentations, negotiations, and contract closure. Working with small and medium-sized businesses, you will identify customer acquisition and retention challenges and demonstrate how loyalty solutions can drive repeat purchases and sustainable growth. You will collaborate closely with Sales Development Representatives and Customer Success to ensure a seamless customer journey, from the first qualified conversation through successful onboarding. By combining consultative selling, disciplined pipeline management, and AI-powered sales tools, you will help accelerate revenue growth in an expanding B2B loyalty market. Develop tailored loyalty propositions: Demonstrate how loyalty currencies, including airline miles and reward points, can help businesses attract new customers, increase spending, strengthen retention, and encourage repeat purchases. Lead presentations and negotiations: Deliver compelling sales presentations, prepare customized proposals, address objections, negotiate commercial terms, and guide decision-makers toward confident purchasing decisions. Maintain deal momentum: Establish clear next steps, engage relevant stakeholders, follow up consistently, and proactively address obstacles throughout the sales process to improve conversion rates and shorten sales cycles. Full-cycle sales ownership: Proven ability to manage opportunities independently from discovery and qualification through presentations, proposals, negotiations, and contract signature. SME sales expertise: Experience selling to small and medium-sized businesses, managing multiple opportunities simultaneously, and adapting sales approaches to different customer needs and buying processes. Commercial understanding of loyalty: Ability to explain loyalty programmes in straightforward business terms and connect proposed solutions to customer acquisition, retention, spending, and overall business economics. Strong communication skills: Excellent presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities, with the confidence to engage business stakeholders and communicate complex propositions clearly. Language proficiency: Fluency in both German and English, with the ability to conduct sales conversations, deliver presentations, and negotiate effectively in both languages.   • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

raw.title: Certification Engineer
raw.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

Start date: Immediately

title: Business Development Manager
description: Grosse Veränderungen beginnen mit Menschen, die mehr erreichen wollen. Wie kommen Mitarbeitende zur Arbeit? Warum stehen Firmenautos ungenutzt herum, während Parkplätze knapp sind? Und wie wird nachhaltige Mobilität zur attraktivsten Wahl? Bei Urban Connect machen wir aus diesen Herausforderungen konkrete Lösungen. Wir verbinden geteilte E-Bikes und Firmenautos, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Mobilitätsbudgets und digitales Parkplatzmanagement auf einer Plattform. Damit helfen wir Unternehmen, Kosten zu senken, Ressourcen besser zu nutzen und ihren Mitarbeitenden mehr Freiheit zu geben. Unternehmen wie Roche, Google, SWISS und Lonza setzen bereits auf uns. Unser Anspruch geht weiter: Wir wollen die Art verändern, wie Unternehmen Mobilität organisieren. Und wir bieten das Betriebssystem, das dies möglich macht. Um diese Vision zu verwirklichen, suchen wir eine neugierige, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Energie und gutes Urteilsvermögen mitbringt und mit uns das Unternehmen und die Mobilitätsbranche voranbringen möchte. Deine Rolle: echte Verantwortung, spürbare Wirkung Du möchtest ein Unternehmen mitgestalten, anspruchsvolle Probleme lösen und sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Als Business Development Manager arbeitest du eng mit unserem Sales- und Account-Management-Team sowie mit Product, Technology und Operations zusammen. Du entwickelst aus Kundenbedürfnissen, Daten und Marktkenntnissen überzeugende Mobilitätslösungen und konkrete Wachstumschancen. Du verantwortest Projekte, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran. Wir erwarten, dass du von Anfang an durchdachte Fragen stellst, erkennst, wo du einen Beitrag leisten kannst, und ins Handeln kommst. Dabei unterstützen dich Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die wollen, dass du erfolgreich bist. Was du bei uns bewegst Aus Daten Chancen machen: Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Marktdaten, etwa zur Auslastung von Fahrzeugen und Parkplätzen, und entwickelst daraus umsetzbare Empfehlungen für bessere betriebliche Mobilitätslösungen. Eigene Projekte vorantreiben: Du verantwortest Projekte wie Produktanalysen, die Bewertung von Geschäftschancen und die Entwicklung betrieblicher Mobilitätskonzepte. Du definierst nächste Schritte, bringst die richtigen Menschen zusammen und erzielst Ergebnisse. Das Produkt verstehen: Du entwickelst ein praxisnahes Verständnis unserer Plattform, der Kundeneinrichtung, Buchungen, Abrechnungen und Integrationen. Für unseren Kunden suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als DevOps Engineer. Werde Teil eines agilen DevOps-Teams und gestalte die digitale Kundenschnittstelle aktiv mit. Gemeinsam verantwortet das Team fünf geschäftskritische eBanking-Applikationen und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei kommen moderne Technologien, innovative Softwarearchitekturen und agile Entwicklungsmethoden wie Pair-/Mob-Programming und TDD zum Einsatz. Eigenverantwortung, Teamarbeit und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung stehen im Mittelpunkt.

 

Hauptaufgaben:

  • Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung und den Betrieb von fünf geschäftskritischen Applikationen rund um das eBanking

  • Weiterentwicklung von Microservices und Self-contained Systems

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung bankfachlicher Anforderungen in nachhaltige technische Lösungen

  • Kontinuierliche Optimierung des Zusammenspiels von Development, Testing, Operations und Monitoring

  • Sicherstellung von Stabilität, Performance, Sicherheit und Verfügbarkeit der verantworteten Services

  • Aktives Einbringen neuer technischer und methodischer Impulse zur Weiterentwicklung des Teams und unserer Produkte

  • Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Softwarearchitekturen und Entwicklungsstandards

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit im agilen DevOps-Team sowie aktive Mitgestaltung einer gemeinsamen Engineering-Kultur


Anforderungen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (Uni, FH oder HF) im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Banking-Umfeld

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Java- und Angular-Entwicklung sowie mit Spring und JPA

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Kotlin sowie im Umgang mit Oracle und PostgreSQL

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Kubernetes und modernen Container-Technologien

  • Erfahrung in der Softwarearchitektur und Entwicklung von internetexponierten Services

  • Verständnis für moderne Architekturansätze wie Microservices, Domain-Driven Design, Resilienz und Observability

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden und Freude an Praktiken wie Pair-/Mob-Programming und Test-Driven Development (TDD)

  • Kenntnisse in JIRA und ein ausgeprägtes DevOps-Mindset

  • Eine team- und kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit mit hoher Eigenmotivation, Eigenverantwortung und Sozialkompetenz

  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit, am Wissensaustausch und an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung

 

Generelle Rahmenbedingungen:

  • Pensum: 100%

  • Einsatz: ab 1. Dezember 2026 bis 1. November 2028

  • Arbeitsort:  vor Ort beim Kunden in Zürich

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse zwingend

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>What is Contentstack?</strong></p> <p>Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.</p> <p>While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.</p> <p>Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce &amp; Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.</p> <p>Learn more at <a class="c-link c-link--focus-visible" href="http://www.contentstack.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://www.contentstack.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.contentstack.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Who Are We?</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!</span></p></div><h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What Are We Looking For?</span></h2> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Business Intelligence Data Architect</strong> to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack.</p> <p>In this high-impact role, you’ll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI &amp; Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making.</p> <p>If you’re passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we’d love to hear from you! Here's what you'll be doing:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead analytical architecture and governance:</strong> Define enterprise modeling standards across staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers. Establish conventions for model grain, naming, ownership, lineage, and documentation, and lead architectural design reviews.</li> <li><strong>Build governed data models and semantic layers:</strong> Design and implement reusable business entities, semantic models, and enterprise metrics that support consistent reporting, self-service analytics, applications, and AI-enabled workflows.</li> <li><strong>Establish analytics engineering best practices:</strong> Set standards for dbt development, testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, deployment reliability, model performance, and observability to improve scalability and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Enable secure, reliable data access:</strong> Design governed access patterns for applications, AI agents, and self-service tools consuming Snowflake data, including role-based access control (RBAC), APIs, service layers, and query optimization.</li> <li><strong>Partner across the business:</strong> Work closely with Data Engineering, BI &amp; Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into trustworthy data models and scalable analytics solutions.</li> <li><strong>Mentor and enable the team:</strong> Guide analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering practices.</li> <li><strong>Drive platform evolution:</strong> Evaluate tools, semantic technologies, governance capabilities, and architectural improvements that support long-term scalability while reducing technical debt.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What Really Gets Us Excited About You</span></h2> <ul> <li>5-8 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including at least 3 years in an architect capacity with direct ownership of an analytical platform.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on expertise in Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouse design, RBAC, materialization strategies, dynamic tables, and query performance optimization.</li> <li>Expert-level experience with dbt, including staging/intermediate/mart conventions, Jinja macros, incremental models, testing, documentation, and reusable modeling patterns.</li> <li>Strong understanding of dimensional and semantic modeling, with the ability to select and justify approaches based on business and analytical needs.</li> <li>Proven experience designing and deploying production semantic layers and governed metrics across BI platforms, analytics applications, and AI-enabled workflows, including text-to-SQL and MCP-based integrations.</li> <li>Advanced SQL skills and experience with Python, along with familiarity with dbt Cloud, Fivetran, Git, CI/CD, and cloud-native analytics environments.</li> <li>Experience designing secure data access patterns for applications consuming Snowflake data, including APIs, service layers, RBAC, query performance, and governed semantic access.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions to technical teams, executive leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe, and India.</li> <li>Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced certification; dbt Certified Data Architect or Analytics Engineer certification.</li> <li>Experience with Snowflake Cortex and Snowpark ML for in-warehouse AI/ML workloads.</li> <li>Experience working with Salesforce as a source system, including dimensional modeling for go-to-market (GTM) data.</li> <li>Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures that connect large language models to governed analytical data.</li> <li>Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.</li> <li>Experience implementing data governance frameworks, including data catalogs, column-level lineage, and row-level security.</li> <li>You value a fun, collaborative, and innovative culture!</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Do We Offer?</strong></p> <p><strong>Interesting Work title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Deepdesk
description: About Deepdesk Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider. The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside. At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks. You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets. We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. raw.title: AI Engineer
raw.description:
About Us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.
Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

 

About the role:

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production.

The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI.

You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services

  • Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately

  • Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform

  • Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time

  • Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality

  • Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t

  • Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them.

  • Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality

  • Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake)

  • Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement

  • Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool

  • Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners

  • A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs.

This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production.

People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers .

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Senior Financieel Strategisch Adviseur | Gemeente Zwolle
description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Gemeente Zwolle op zoek naar een Senior Financieel Strategisch Adviseur. Binnen de afdeling Concernstaf werk je aan een strategische en impactvolle opgave: het ontwikkelen van een integraal Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP) met een horizon van tien jaar en een bijbehorend financieel sturingskader. De gemeente staat de komende jaren voor grote investeringen op het gebied van woningbouw, gebiedsontwikkeling, onderwijshuisvesting en infrastructuur. Tegelijkertijd vragen financiële schaarste, beperkte uitvoeringscapaciteit en netcongestie om scherpe keuzes en integrale afwegingen. In deze opdracht zorg je voor een toekomstbestendige financiële aanpak die inzicht geeft in investeringen, risico’s, financiële consequenties en prioriteiten binnen de gemeentelijke investeringsportefeuille. Deze interim opdracht is interessant voor een ervaren strategisch financieel adviseur met ruime ervaring binnen gemeentelijke organisaties, financiële sturing en investeringsvraagstukken in het fysieke domein. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integraal Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP) met een looptijd van tien jaar. Je ontwikkelt een financieel sturingskader voor gemeentelijke investeringen, inclusief financiële uitgangspunten en besluitvormingscriteria. Je ontwikkelt een methodiek voor integrale prioritering van investeringsprojecten op basis van financiële, bestuurlijke en organisatorische factoren. Je adviseert over de aansluiting van het MIP en het sturingskader op de planning- en controlcyclus (P&C-cyclus). Je verzorgt de implementatie, overdracht en documentatie zodat de organisatie zelfstandig kan doorwerken met de ontwikkelde instrumenten. Wat vragen wij? Eisen: Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-bacheloropleiding. Je hebt minimaal 10 jaar ervaring als strategisch financieel adviseur of in een vergelijkbare financieel-strategische adviesfunctie. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen een gemeentelijke organisatie. Aanvullende wensen: Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financieel instrumentarium. Je hebt ruime kennis van en ervaring met gemeentefinanciën. Je hebt ervaring met financiële vraagstukken binnen het fysieke domein, zoals gebiedsontwikkeling, woningbouw of infrastructuur. Je hebt gewerkt binnen een groeiende gemeente met meer dan 100.000 inwoners. Je hebt ervaring met advisering aan bestuur, directie en senior management. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen en opleveren van een Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP). Competenties Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Je hebt gevoel voor politiek-bestuurlijke verhoudingen en stakeholders. Je bent daadkrachtig, resultaatgericht en brengt complexe opgaven tot een concreet eindresultaat. Je werkt zelfstandig en zoekt op het juiste moment actief de samenwerking op. Informatie  Start: Zo snel mogelijk Aantal uur: 24 tot 36 uur per week Lengte opdracht: 6 maanden met optie tot verlenging Locatie: Zwolle Vorm: ZZP Geïnteresseerd? Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor maandag 9 november 9.00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht. raw.description:
About the role

As a Senior Business Development Lead at SkyNRG, you’ll build and grow partnerships with large corporate customers looking to address the emissions associated with their business travel and air freight.

You’ll be responsible for developing new customer relationships and growing existing ones, from understanding a company’s sustainability goals and business needs to shaping proposals, negotiating agreements and closing deals. Working with senior decision makers and colleagues across SkyNRG, you’ll help customers understand how SAF certificates (SAFc) can form part of their approach to reducing aviation-related emissions.

This is a senior commercial role for someone who enjoys building relationships, navigating complex sales processes and turning customer interest into long-term partnerships. You’ll combine strategic account development with a hands-on approach to progressing opportunities and delivering commercial results.

 

Your responsibilites

  • Win new strategic customers and grow existing partnerships.

  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders and guide them through their SAF journey.

  • Lead commercial opportunities from first conversation through to signed agreement, nurturing the relationship at every stage and ensuring a high-quality customer experience.

  • Develop account and engagement plans for high-priority customers and partners.

  • Create new opportunities through networking, outreach, events, and referrals.

  • Share customer and market insights to help continuously improve our commercial approach and propositions.

  • Management of industry initiatives and client-facing campaigns.

  • Work closely with colleagues across SkyNRG to ensure customers receive a seamless experience.

 

Your profile

We're looking for someone who is commercially sharp, curious by nature, and motivated by helping organisations make meaningful progress towards their sustainability goals.

Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of experience in a consultative B2B business development, sales, or commercial role, preferably within SAF, energy, carbon, or similarly complex or emerging markets.

  • A proven track record of developing new business and converting strategic opportunities into commercial partnerships.

  • Experience building and maintaining relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • Experience leading complex commercial discussions and contract negotiations involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer needs with business objectives.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Experience working with CRM systems and data-driven business development processes.

  • The ability and motivation to quickly build expertise in SAF, SAF certificates, and the evolving regulatory landscape.

  • A continuous improvement mindset, and willingness to act as an ambassador for SkyNRG and its values: Driven, Genuine, Change-maker

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in SAF, aviation, carbon markets or related sectors.

  • Experience working in a scale-up or fast-growing business.

  • Experience with HubSpot.

  • A relevant professional network that can help open doors and create opportunities.

 

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

 

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

 

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • 30 paid holidays + 2 for choosing sustainable travel options for your holidays

  • Contribute to a sustainable organization (B Corp)

  • Attractive bonus scheme

  • €5.000,- dedicated budget every 3 years for professional development

  • Commuting travel reimbursement + Lease a Bike plan

  • An office in the city centre of Amsterdam (Nieuwmarkt)

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office) working arrangements

  • Generous employer pension contribution

  • Paid Volunteering Day

  • Access to our electric company boat (also available for private use), free lunch, and lots of social activities – all part of the deal!

 

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services.

At SkyNRG, we deeply value inclusion and diversity. title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
description: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01 Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten. Over de functie Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar): Werk je in dagdienst Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01 Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek. In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028): Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces. Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta. Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren. Jouw profiel SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten.

 

Over de functie

Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie.

Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar):

  • Werk je in dagdienst

  • Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01

  • Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators

  • Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie

  • Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek.

In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028):

  • Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces.

  • Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta.

  • Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren.

SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

raw.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

  • Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

  • Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

  • Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

  • Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

  • Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

  • You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

  • You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

  • You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

  • You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

  • You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

  • You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

  • You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

  • You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

  • You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

  • You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!
